words.gloss: if one is able to do

literal: Within one birth, like a turtle, if one is able to restrain the five, it has protection throughout seven births.
translation: If a person can restrain their five senses in a single birth like a turtle withdrawing its limbs, that self-control will serve as a protective shield throughout all seven of their future births.
modern: ஒரு பிறவியில் ஆமை தன் ஐந்து உறுப்புகளையும் அடக்குவது போல ஒருவன் தன் ஐந்து புலன்களையும் அடக்கிக் காக்க வல்லவனானால், அது அவனுக்கு ஏழு பிறவிகளிலும் பாதுகாப்பாக அமையும்.
explanation: This couplet compares self-control to a turtle withdrawing its five limbs into its shell for safety. If a person can master and restrain their five senses within a single lifetime, this discipline becomes an enduring strength. The poet asserts that the protective power of such self-control is not temporary; it safeguards the individual across all future births. The key words 'ஐந்தடக்கல்' (restraining the five senses) and 'ஏமாப்பு' (protection/shield) emphasize that self-discipline is the ultimate armor for the soul.
